description: The plot illustrates the relationship between Average Lagging (AL) and BLEU scores for four different methods. The x-axis is labeled "Average Lagging (AL)" and features a linear scale ranging from 0 to 8, with numeric tick labels at intervals of 2. The y-axis is labeled "BLEU" and uses a linear scale ranging from 20 to 30, with numeric tick labels at intervals of 2, though the label for 28 is obscured by a grey rectangle. Horizontal dashed grid lines correspond to the y-axis ticks. The line representing "Consistency-CE" is a light purple dashed line with circle markers; it shows an upward trend across the x-axis, starting at an x-value of approximately 0.4 with a y-value of 20.2, and rising steadily to end at an x-value of roughly 7.8 with a y-value of 29.7. The "Inconsistency-CE" line is a dark purple dashed line with square markers, which also increases across the plot, beginning at an x-value of approximately 1.3 and a y-value of 22.3, and concluding at an x-value near 7.8 with a y-value of 29.8. The "Inconsistency-CE-MP" line is depicted as a blue dashed line with square markers, following an upward trajectory that starts at an x-value of about 0.7 and a y-value of 22.3, and finishes at an x-value of approximately 7.8 with a y-value of 29.4. Finally, the "Consistency-Bi" line is a red solid line with star markers that demonstrates an increasing trend, initiating at an x-value of roughly 0.8 with a y-value of 24.9, and reaching a final value at an x-value of about 7.8 and a y-value of 30.1.
